map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin and Hamilton publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-31 03:00): early in person 38,833 (state 38,019); ballots sent 16,952 (state 16,940). Clermont (as of 2026-10-31 10:37): early in person 17,816 (state 17,354). Crawford (as of 2026-10-30 15:41): mail returned 1,886 (state 1,879). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-30 19:48): early in person 47,769 (state 47,645). Franklin (as of 2026-10-31 00:12): early in person 84,397 (state 82,532). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-30 20:09): early in person 69,238 (state 67,744).
